## Cross-repo mesh — `shared`

**shared library integration**, one package of [`createos-plugin`](https://github.com/NodeOps-app/createos-plugin). `sandbox-engine.ts` — the shared CLI driver the plugin packages build on. The most CLI-coupled code here, so a command or flag rename lands first.

### What ripples into this package

**This package has no page in the public docs.** A user-visible change here has nowhere to land — flag that rather than shipping it undocumented.
